learning_outcomes.text: Recognizes hazards and risk factors in the workplace.
Describes methods of protection from work accidents and occupational diseases
Defines fire, fire protection and first aid methods
Knows and applies occupational hygiene and occupational health and safety rules in the workplace
Have knowledge about occupational health and safety legislation.
Knows personal protective equipment and the necessity of its use.

syllabus_topics: OHS in Turkey and the World, historical development of OHS
Biological Risk Factors, Workplace Hygiene and Order
Information on Labor Legislation, Legal Rights and Responsibilities of Employees
Accidents at work; Reasons, Prevention Principles and Application of Techniques
Causes of Occupational Diseases; Disease Prevention Principles and Application of Prevention Techniques
Legal Consequences Arising from Work Accidents and Occupational Diseases
First Aid, Harms and Passivates of Tobacco Products
Manual Lifting and Carrying, Safe Use of Work Equipment
Working with Displayed Vehicles, Electricity, Dangers, Risks and Precautions
Flash, Explosion, Fire and Fire Protection; Evacuation and Rescue
Personal Protective Equipment and Its Use
Safety and Health Signs and other issues
bibliography: Occupational Health and Safety Law No. 6331 and Related Regulations
Other Legislation Related to Occupational Health and Safety.
Kocabaş, S. (2019) Occupational Health and Safety Basic Training Lecture Notes. ZBEU Faculty of Engineering, Department of Environmental Engineering. Zonguldak. 420 p.
